configurations.name: site
configurations.comment: python -m http.server sends no Cache-Control, so browsers apply heuristic caching to the ES modules and CSVs and keep serving stale copies after an edit. Same static serve, plus no-store.
runtimeArgs:
import http.server, socketserver
class H(http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):
    def end_headers(self):
        self.send_header('Cache-Control', 'no-store, max-age=0')
        super().end_headers()
socketserver.ThreadingTCPServer.allow_reuse_address = True
with socketserver.ThreadingTCPServer(('127.0.0.1', 4173), H) as httpd:
    print('serving on http://127.0.0.1:4173')
    httpd.serve_forever()
